correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the exact arrival updates and centering F_n=E_n-L_n(P_n/n)-n/4, W_n=L_n-n/2. The conditional mean includes the nonzero correction in E(C_{n+1}|T_n); checked predictable martingale innovations xi and depth-dispersion Welford update. Uniform recursive-tree depth exponential moments imply height O(log n) moments, Q_n/log n→1 in L2, leaf fraction→1/2 and conditional xi variance/log n→1/4. Weighted predictable variance 1/12 and fourth-moment Lindeberg yield F_n/sqrt(n log n)⇒N(0,1/12); ratio by L_n/n→1/2 doubles variance to 1/3. Independent exact rational checks over all recursive parent choices n=2..7 confirm the local innovation variance identity; they are not an infinite CLT proof.

originality.rationale: Lundblad–Wagner (2026) Theorem 6 for uniform recursive trees gives the *same mean leaf-depth minus mean vertex-depth statistic* tending to 1/2, with first two moment limits, but no sqrt(n/log n) Gaussian statement; its Lemma14 only provides dominant moments. Grübel–Kabluchko (2015) have a Gaussian martingale-tail result for internal total path length and a separate binary-search-tree external-node statistic, neither matching the coupled actual-leaf/vertex-depth ratio. The submitted Gaussian variance 1/3 is not mechanically implied by these prior statements.
residual_risks: A previously unnoticed joint external/internal path-length CLT might imply this specific ratio, despite the inspected Theorem 6 being first-order only; novelty remains best-of-knowledge.

final_claim: For a uniformly grown recursive tree with actual zero-child leaves, sqrt(n/log n)(E_n/L_n-P_n/n-1/2) converges weakly to N(0,1/3), where E_n sums leaf depths, L_n is leaf count, P_n all-vertex depth sum.
limitations: Uniform one-parent recursive trees and actual leaves only; no moving weights, conditioning or functional limit. Source recorded no Lean/expert proof, and finite tests certify local identities only.
